answer: Each identity files a behavior fingerprint in escrow: tide-timed pearl dives plus one relic pearl whose rings anchor the record. Each epoch it logs dives on the tide chart; auditors replay the log, recheck the rings, and a borrowed fingerprint burns the 70-credit bond. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct relic pearls at 150 each: 150,000; honest divers pay 150 once. A rented-fingerprint ring fails: one pearl's rings match only one dive history.
